description: This file defines the WorkspaceController class with methods for managing workspaces, including create, read, switch, update, delete, and sharing functionalities, in a server-side application using Express and TypeORM.

classes.name: WorkspaceController
classes.description: Controller class handling workspace-related API endpoints such as create, read, switch, update, delete, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new workspace using data from the request body.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves workspace(s) based on provided query parameters (id or organizationId).

methods.name: switchWorkspace
methods.description: Switches the current workspace context for the logged-in user, updating session and permissions.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing workspace with data from the request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a workspace identified by the request parameter id.

methods.name: getSharedWorkspacesForItem
methods.description: Retrieves shared workspaces associated with a specific item id.

methods.name: setSharedWorkspacesForItem
methods.description: Sets shared workspaces for a specific item based on request body.
